name: Annie Alois Schultz
source:
A rare combination of the brainy and the sexy, Annie is stunning wherever she goes. However, she assumes a mysterious air, which is most baffling for others. Ironically, she utterly enjoys the chaos she causes.

Her sudden appearance in the battle against [url=/c137387]Chava Fon[/url] saved everyone.
